@about: Cabinets add-on (0.8 SU.1035). Words of the add-on only; part names are keys of lib/model.js.
cmd.cabinet.help: Place cabinets along a wall: pick the wall line and the room side, then type each cabinet's width.
cmd.cabelev.help: Draw the front view of the cabinets on one wall; it stays up to date.
cmd.cablist.help: The cut list of every cabinet: pieces and area by material, edge banding, problems.
cmd.cabnest.help: Nest every material on sheets and say how many sheets the job takes.
ask.wall.a: First point of the wall line:
ask.wall.b: Second point of the wall line:
ask.room: Click on the room side of the wall:
ask.cab: {type} cabinet width, or click its end ({w} is usual; at {at} of {len}) [Base/Drawer base/Wall/Tall/Gap/Undo] <Enter to finish>:
ask.elev.pick: Pick a cabinet on the wall to draw:
ask.elev.at: Where does the front view go?
err.wall: The two points of the wall line are the same.
err.empty: There are no cabinets in this drawing.
warn.past: This cabinet runs past the end of the wall line ({len}).
warn.units: {n} cabinets were drawn in other units and are not in this list.

warn.barcode.one: 1 label had no room for a readable bar code; its id is written on it.
warn.barcode.other: {n} labels had no room for a readable bar code; their ids are written on them.

done.list.export: EXPORT saves the cut list (CSV), the labels and the nested sheets (DXF).
done.nest.export: EXPORT saves the nested sheets as DXF for your CAM program, and the labels in cutting order.
prob.too-narrow: Too narrow for its two sides (at least {min}).
prob.too-low: Too low for its panels (at least {min}).
prob.too-shallow: Too shallow for its back and shelves (at least {min}).
prob.no-slide: No drawer slide fits this depth (at least {min}).
prob.drawer-low: A drawer front is too low for a drawer box (at least {min}).
prob.fronts-tall: The drawer fronts and gaps ({sum}) are taller than the box ({max}).
export.labels.title: Labels {name}
csv.name: Name
set.build.note: Construction settings apply to cabinets you place from now on; each cabinet keeps the rules it was built with.
cmd.cabside.help: Draw a cabinet cut through its middle, seen from the side: panels, back, shelves, plinth, fronts.
cmd.cabdrill.help: The 32 mm drilling of every cabinet: shelf pins, hinge cups and plates, drawer slide holes.
cmd.cabhard.help: The hardware list: hinges, plates, shelf pins, slides, legs, brackets, pulls, fasteners.
cmd.cab3d.help: Put the cabinets on the 3D tab as solids (kept up to date when the Solids setting is on).
ask.side.pick: Pick the cabinet to draw from the side:
ask.side.at: Where does the side view go?
solid.name: Cabinet {no}
drill.note.plates: (hinge plates on the hinge side only)
drill.note.mirrored: (a pair of doors: the second is the mirror image)
done.drill: {holes} holes in all (a side is one part of two: drill it on its inside face).
done.drill.export: EXPORT › Cabinet drilling (CSV) writes every hole: x along the part, y across it, from the edges noted in the help.
done.hard.export: EXPORT › Cabinet hardware (CSV) writes the list.
csvd.name: Name
set.solids: Keep the cabinets on the 3D tab
